hypotheses.statement: The faintness is an artefact of antialiasing and subpixel rendering combined with the low contrast (4.48:1) and the specific viewport/DPI combination.
hypotheses.prediction: The rendered pixels inside the hint’s own rect will show a bimodal distribution with peaks at 242 and 255, and the min value will be ≥230 in both scrolled and unscrolled states.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any pixel value ≤220 inside the hint’s rect in either state falsifies this hypothesis.

hypotheses.statement: A translucent sticky heading (z-8, bg-white/90) overlaps the hint, reducing its effective contrast.
hypotheses.prediction: In the scrolled state where the hint is centered, elementsFromPoint at the hint’s center will return the sticky heading as the topmost element with opacity <1 and backgroundColor rgb(255,255,255) or similar.
hypotheses.falsifier: No overlapping element with opacity <1 or backgroundColor affecting the hint’s rect in the scrolled state falsifies this hypothesis.

hypotheses.statement: The hint is clipped or scrolled out of view in the unscrolled state, and only becomes visible (but faint) when scrolled into the center.
hypotheses.prediction: In the unscrolled state, the hint’s rect will have y < 0 or y + height > innerHeight, and in the scrolled state, the hint’s rect will be fully within the viewport.
hypotheses.falsifier: The hint’s rect is fully within the viewport in both scrolled and unscrolled states falsifies this hypothesis.

probe.question: Why does the hint look faint? Measure geometry, overlap, styles, and rendered pixels in scrolled vs. unscrolled states.
probe.falsifier: Any hypothesis is falsified if its falsifier condition is met.
controls: viewport measurements (innerWidth, innerHeight, scrollX, scrollY, docHeight) in both states
hint’s rect and effective style in both states
elementsFromPoint at 3 points inside the hint’s rect in both states
rendered pixels inside the hint’s rect in both states
limitations: Only viewport-coordinate measurements are possible; no access to layout tree or computed styles outside the sandbox.
Pixels are greyscale 0-255; color accuracy is limited.
No access to font metrics or subpixel rendering details.
Only 3 points for elementsFromPoint due to call limit.
